_doc: Motedis Aluprofil 40x40 B-Typ Nut 10: a 40 mm aluminium profile made to match Bosch Rexroth's 10 mm slot. Outer size, opening, slot depth, bore and the section figures are from Motedis' own data picture; what it does not print (lip, cavity width, corner radius, the corner hollows) is Rexroth's figure and marked community. Motedis names no alloy ("Eloxiertes Aluminium"), so the material is the alloy such profiles are usually made of, said in its rule. The drawn outline leaves out the true shape of the corner hollows, the bore's square form with its notches and the steps on the lips, so it comes out about a tenth heavier than Motedis' figures.
